name: Golden Frostbound Oath
assumptions: Passive "Dawn's Salutation Returned" is not modelled yet: the weapon contributes only its base ATK and secondary stat. R1 text: Increase DEF by 16%. When the equipping character's Elemental Skill or Lunar-Crystallize attacks hit opponents, gain the Frost Fae's Favor effect for 6s: Geo DMG inflicted by the equipping character increases by 40%, Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG increases by 40%. While this effect is active, if there are Moondrifts near the equipping character, all other nearby party members will gain the Frost Fae's Mischief effect: Geo DMG dealt increases by 20% and Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG increases by 20%. This effect can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
Obtain method is a guess from rarity and has not been verified in a source page.
Base ATK and secondary stat are from genshin-db only (not cross-checked in a second source).
